title: Fixes & enhancements

entries.title: Aurora kernel packaging and the wip2 trial
entries.provided: Builds and packages pinned Aurora sources for this Ubuntu/elementary stack, with distinct kernel/module identities and retained fallback payloads. Aurora supplies the underlying Apple drivers.
entries.verification: October 21 wip2 receipts record attended boot, PMP/idle accounting, GLES shader/readback and a 1 MiB fsync check on J314S.
entries.limitation: These are scoped checks, not a stable kernel release, complete source-parity audit or sustained hardware qualification. .20 remains the persistent default.
entries.next_step: Record an attended return to the .20 fallback before suspend or controlled energy comparisons.
entries.delivery: Experimental package and attended host trial

entries.title: 7.2.11 wip3 staged beside the fallbacks
entries.provided: A separate audited CI package combines the selected upstream 7.2.11 and external-display colour work; a non-default trial entry and initramfs are staged.
entries.verification: The October 21 staging receipt verifies installed files, 91 early modules, clean package verification and unchanged shared boot.bin.
entries.limitation: The entry is unarmed and unbooted. Source candidate PR #413 remains separate from the merged staging record. No new Touch ID or display success follows.
entries.next_step: At the owner’s chosen trial, bind boot and highest dock gate to the exact package; retain .20 and wip2 recovery assets.
entries.delivery: Installed, unarmed trial package

entries.title: WD22TB4 picture on all three Mac USB-C ports
entries.provided: Integrates the Aurora display/USB4 stack and adds identity-bound collection and per-port timing tools. This is not a claim that the project authored Aurora’s dock driver.
entries.verification: October 21 owner confirmations cover 1080p/60 dock picture on rear-left, front-left and right Mac ports; front-left/right also have explicit input confirmation.
entries.limitation: One plug cycle per port, with a corrected label and sampling boundary. The approximately 4.5 s pilot is detection-to-active-state, not cable-to-visible-pixels or a port speed ranking.
entries.next_step: Repeat matched per-port hotplug/recovery cycles and collect lifecycle traces before tuning delays.
entries.delivery: Scoped physical J314S/dock observation

entries.title: Native Touch ID settings; matching remains blocked
entries.provided: Provides an Aurora SEP/fprintd installation path and a native Settings page with enrolment, removal and scoped sudo/polkit controls. Public driver work comes from Aurora.
entries.verification: The wip2 sensor/enrolment path was exercised; the enclave finishes enrolment but the xART guard refuses the required save. Private fake-fprintd UI/PAM checks are recorded.
entries.limitation: Matching remains blocked. The guard is unchanged. UI fixtures do not prove authentication, lock-screen support, passkeys or macOS interoperability.
entries.next_step: Resolve the owner-controlled guard decision, then perform narrowly scoped matching/PAM acceptance while retaining password fallback.
entries.delivery: Settings installed; authentication blocked

entries.title: Apple Wi-Fi resume recovery
entries.provided: Ports Apple-gated Broadcom recovery to Ubuntu/NetworkManager and supplies firmware/first-boot wiring rather than Arch hooks.
entries.verification: Source and regression checks cover device gating and recovery handling; the port map distinguishes supported chip families.
entries.limitation: This does not establish repeatable Wi-Fi resume on the current wip2 kernel or a freshly booted factory image. Unsupported Broadcom models are not silently included.
entries.next_step: Complete repeated suspend/resume on the exact supported board/kernel after recovery prerequisites pass.
entries.delivery: Factory/source integration; current hardware acceptance open

entries.title: Speaker protection and optional DSP installation
entries.provided: Installs Ubuntu’s speakersafetyd and optionally the Asahi model/DSP packages, with an LV2-plugin prerequisite. Protection and DSP algorithms are upstream components.
entries.verification: The retained desktop record reports working output through the matched safety/DSP chain; the installer explicitly checks the LV2 path before DSP setup.
entries.limitation: The factory package list still lacks this complete audio path. A prior desktop playback pass is not a current wip2 audio/replug qualification.
entries.next_step: Close factory packaging and then qualify output, volume restoration and resume on the exact image.
entries.delivery: Desktop installer; complete factory path remains open

entries.title: Recover an unresponsive PipeWire/WirePlumber stack
entries.provided: Adds a Pantheon user-service watchdog plus no-suspend/headset-priority rules. It requires repeated probe failures, a restart budget and active/unlocked session checks.
entries.verification: The implementation has budget, session and failure-path unit tests; the recorded installation enabled the user service.
entries.limitation: The logind lock-state boundary and repeated real logout/resume recovery need physical acceptance. A timer being enabled is not proof of successful recovery.
entries.next_step: Exercise a controlled audio failure and lock/resume cases without bypassing speaker safety.
entries.delivery: Desktop user service and image-layer source

entries.title: Headset-mic priority, without an unnecessary stereo mapper
entries.provided: Supplies the headset-mic priority rule. Deliberately omits Omarchy’s Quickshell-specific mono-to-stereo meter workaround because the Pantheon indicator accepts mono sources.
entries.verification: The current port-map explanation and WirePlumber configuration agree on this boundary.
entries.limitation: Omitting that mapper is not an unimplemented Pantheon feature. It also does not establish end-to-end recording quality in every app.
entries.next_step: Investigate a real silent-recording report if one occurs; qualify recording and input selection separately.
entries.delivery: Priority rule; stereo reconciliation intentionally omitted

entries.title: AVD decode tools and a contained browser experiment
entries.provided: Provides bridge/firmware setup and an optional separate YouTube browser path, with factory dependency and launcher wiring. Apple AVD, VA-API and browser decoding remain upstream.
entries.verification: October 18 notes record advertised codecs and a scoped contained-browser decode result; the repository includes factory/launcher contracts.
entries.limitation: Ordinary sandboxed Brave, the current wip2 combination and factory hardware decode are not thereby qualified. The optional browser’s media-sandbox tradeoff must remain explicit.
entries.next_step: Qualify codecs and real client behavior on the selected kernel without presenting the experiment as a default browser fix.
entries.delivery: Optional runtime experiment and factory source wiring

entries.title: 80% charge limit and CPU power policy
entries.provided: Adds the SMC charge-threshold CLI/policy, Quick Settings switch, battery-aware CPU cap/follow modes and related memory tuning.
entries.verification: Historical desktop receipts observed an 80% threshold. Source tests cover cap/install failure handling and the native control.
entries.limitation: A charge threshold or governor label is not measured battery-life improvement. Physical unplug transitions and combined policy effects remain separate acceptance.
entries.next_step: Verify battery/AC transitions and matched responsiveness/energy behavior with settled controls.
entries.delivery: Desktop policy and native switch

entries.title: Power reports that keep missing display controls unknown
entries.provided: Supplies sleep-cost/power reports and preserves modes/layout when optional PowerSaveMode is missing, while leaving full-context availability false.
entries.verification: The October 21 tooling report records partial-capability and trial-readiness regressions; unmatched observational windows are explicitly rejected as optimization evidence.
entries.limitation: No controlled Linux/macOS active-use parity, idle floor, battery runtime or aggregate saving follows from these tools.
entries.next_step: After fallback recovery, collect alternating matched trials with complete control/sensor semantics.
entries.delivery: Measurement tooling; no new power experiment

entries.title: Brightness keys, OSD and Quick Settings controls
entries.provided: Routes Pantheon brightness actions through a shell bridge and adds screen/keyboard sliders to native Quick Settings.
entries.verification: Bridge/key contracts and shared prepared-source tests exist; prior D-Bus/backlight calls succeeded.
entries.limitation: Successful calls are narrower than physical-key response, calibrated brightness or persistence across every login/display state.
entries.next_step: Check physical keys, OSD, restore behavior and keyboard-only operation in the exact loaded session.
entries.delivery: Native controls and session bridge

entries.title: Ambient keyboard lighting with manual-override handling
entries.provided: A Pantheon implementation uses the Apple AOP sensor and UPower, with deadband, manual-override pause and active/unlocked/lid gates.
entries.verification: A dated hardware observation read 141 lux and adjusted the keyboard from 0 to 59/255; sensor/state unit tests are present.
entries.limitation: That single observation is not physical appearance, lock/lid or suspend/resume qualification. It never adjusts the display brightness.
entries.next_step: Qualify manual override and lock/lid/suspend transitions on the owner’s session.
entries.delivery: Optional per-user helper

entries.title: Monitor layout profiles and reversible display settings
entries.provided: Stores layouts by monitor identity and adds arrange/diagnose controls with offered modes, profile save/apply and a keep-or-revert timer.
entries.verification: Profile and diagnosis unit checks plus private renders are documented; a local built-in VRR profile had a scoped visual pass.
entries.limitation: Real drag/Apply workflows, repeated hotplug and sustained VRR are not all qualified. Saved fixed modes can override temporary VRR choices.
entries.next_step: Check reversible Apply and laptop-only/docked profile recovery under the current compositor.
entries.delivery: Optional profile watcher and settings app

entries.title: Bluetooth controls inside Quick Settings
entries.provided: Adds asynchronous adapter power and saved-device connect/disconnect controls, with live BlueZ state and pairing handed to Settings.
entries.verification: The private fake-BlueZ production-widget test covers filtering, failure recovery and radio toggles. The duplicate session Bluetooth icon was addressed separately.
entries.limitation: Fixture toggles do not establish real device connection, audio routing or next-login behavior. The control does not automatically scan or pair.
entries.next_step: Qualify the loaded widget with selected real devices while preserving the working phone session.
entries.delivery: Native patched panel; physical connection checks separate

entries.title: Experimental Rust compositor for the Pantheon desktop
entries.provided: Implements the project’s shell/window/input contracts on Smithay, beside a retained Gala session; it is not a port of Mutter.
entries.verification: Native M1 Pro scanout and subsequent desktop use are recorded. Cargo tests and isolated Wayland/XWayland probes cover selected behavior.
entries.limitation: Retained CPU samples use unmatched workloads. No general speed, energy, latency or full Gala parity claim is established.
entries.next_step: Keep loaded-package identities explicit and qualify matched input, frame pacing, recovery and sustained daily-use behavior.
entries.delivery: Experimental installed session; Gala rollback retained

entries.title: Popup stacking, app activation and typing preservation
entries.provided: Adds a popup-aware render/hit-test stack and activation policy that defers untrusted raises while the user types, plus bounded display lifecycle tracing.
entries.verification: Source unit tests and private two-client input/activation probes are retained; October 21 deployment records distinguish installed changes from the older loaded executable.
entries.limitation: Passing nested probes does not mean every real popup, password prompt and dock action is accepted on the loaded session.
entries.next_step: After the owner-chosen login, verify focus/typing and popup routing against the exact installed build.
entries.delivery: Source merged; deployment/load boundaries recorded

entries.title: Recover instead of leaving an output black after a busy flip
entries.provided: Recognizes EBUSY from DRM queue_frame, leaves a retry pending and returns to a bounded retry/reset path rather than permanently abandoning scanout.
entries.verification: The reviewed source contains an explicit busy-retry flag, consecutive-pass bound and production call-site handling.
entries.limitation: Source control flow is not proof that the owner’s black-screen event is reproduced or fixed in a loaded build.
entries.next_step: Retain a failure/recovery trace for the actual affected output and verify the retry bound on hardware.
entries.delivery: Merged source fix; physical regression acceptance open

entries.title: Native half/quarter snapping and a window recovery chooser
entries.provided: Keeps half-snap policy and adds Gala quarters/corner previews, corresponding Rust window handling, and an explicit chooser to restore minimized windows.
entries.verification: Isolated GTK Wayland/XWayland geometry, Escape, restore and typing probes are documented. The chooser checks the running compositor’s focus-routing capability.
entries.limitation: Gala plugin and Rust paths have different load requirements; physical multi-monitor acceptance must not be inferred from one nested output.
entries.next_step: Qualify each supported session on real monitors, including minimum-size windows and dock work-area changes.
entries.delivery: Compositor-specific source and installers

entries.title: Finger-following workspace and overview gestures
entries.provided: Adds configurable swipes, launcher pinch, app gesture forwarding and spring-based workspace/overview previews, honoring animation preferences.
entries.verification: The deployment record retains native package/build checks and isolated pixel/state smoke checks, with an installed gesture package.
entries.limitation: That record says installed for a later login, not loaded by the installation. Physical trackpad gestures, native pacing and mixed windows remain open.
entries.next_step: At an owner-chosen login, verify cancellation, direction, settings, multiple outputs and physical pacing.
entries.delivery: Staged compositor package

entries.title: Windows-style taskbar and Start menu
entries.provided: Patches elementary Dock with a full-width taskbar, Start/search and native CodexBar/RepoBar integrations. Canonical preparation preserves the full customized source set.
entries.verification: Build, GTK hover/focus and launcher/running-marker probes plus recovery-source preservation receipts are retained.
entries.limitation: An earlier partial rebuild replaced the required taskbar and was rolled back. Feature presence is not proof of every launcher group, pin or session-persistence path.
entries.next_step: Use only canonical preparation, retain the known-good package and verify real launcher focus/grouping after any load.
entries.delivery: Patched elementary Dock; exact deployment matters

entries.title: Scheduled Windows Work Mode with restoration
entries.provided: Adds native Settings, wallpaper/icon/dock state snapshots, schedule and optional public-IP/CIDR rules, plus taskbar/top-panel integration.
entries.verification: Pure rule, installer and preference-preservation tests are present. The implementation intersects enabled rules and handles stale IP observations per uplink.
entries.limitation: It does not detect work from a dock/display. Real network/taskbar transitions and compositor load acceptance remain separate.
entries.next_step: Qualify schedule boundaries, route changes and restoration on the exact loaded combination.
entries.delivery: Optional Settings panel and per-user timer

entries.title: One text-size ladder across controls and dock consumers
entries.provided: Provides a shared size-system manifest, text-size control, dock tokens and lint rules that bound justified exceptions.
entries.verification: Consumer tests cover absent/unmanaged/malformed token outputs; native text-scale tests and strict size lint run in CI.
entries.limitation: Some taskbar/panel constants remain explicit exceptions. This is not a claim that every app honors text scaling or passes accessibility review.
entries.next_step: Retire remaining exceptions with actual large-text/narrow-layout checks, keeping owner-selected sizes deliberate.
entries.delivery: Shared source policy and optional watcher

entries.title: Notch-aware panel layout and startup ordering
entries.provided: Prepares a full-height J314S desktop, protected panel/notch allocation, dock work areas and bounded startup readiness instead of assuming a visible dock.
entries.verification: Full-height, panel-scale/notch and disabled-dock startup regressions are retained, with separate installation records.
entries.limitation: The factory starts cropped. Fresh-login, mixed-output/full-height reboot and physical panel acceptance are not equivalent to a native build or fixture pass.
entries.next_step: Qualify full-height startup and output changes with the actual installed kernel/compositor/panel set.
entries.delivery: Desktop profile; factory full-height acceptance open

entries.title: Screenshot shelf that always retains originals
entries.provided: Adds a shelf, Copy/Show/Markup and staged drag/portal export. Saved originals survive accepted, refused and cancelled drops; only temporary transfer assets expire.
entries.verification: The October 21 correction includes seven private GTK regressions covering retention, retry, clipboard fallback, staging and cleanup.
entries.limitation: A finished drag does not prove Signal attached/read the image. The two-minute transfer grace is not an acknowledgement; real target acceptance remains open.
entries.next_step: Verify actual Signal attachment preview/content without sending, multiple captures and cross-session copy/paste.
entries.delivery: Shelf source/installer; real drop-target acceptance pending

entries.title: Readable launcher and hotkey app drawers
entries.provided: Adds an app launcher with explicit search text styling and Gala hotkey drawers that group/position selected app windows with live config reload.
entries.verification: Source and retained implementation records cover launcher styling and the Gala plugin’s assignment/toggle paths.
entries.limitation: Gala-only drawers are not automatically implemented in the Rust session. Historical installation does not qualify current session shortcuts and input focus.
entries.next_step: Map each shortcut to its supported compositor and confirm real typing, assignment and multi-output placement.
entries.delivery: Optional launcher and Gala plugin

entries.title: Theme accents, dark mode and rounded-corner patches
entries.provided: Provides local theme settings, a sunrise/sunset dark-mode helper and scoped Gala/panel styling patches rather than replacing the elementary toolkit.
entries.verification: Installers and source assets are present; prior transformed-desktop records describe the applied theme.
entries.limitation: A Gala corner patch does not apply to Rust rendering automatically. Blanket “installed” does not establish consistency in every app or loaded session.
entries.next_step: Audit light/dark and high-text-size surfaces per toolkit, retaining native defaults where customization is unsupported.
entries.delivery: Optional desktop settings and source patches

entries.title: CodexBar: upstream usage engine plus native elementary layer
entries.provided: Integrates upstream Linux ARM64 CodexBar and adds native Wingpanel/settings, cached session accounting and scoped Codex/Claude/OpenCode account helpers.
entries.verification: The port manifest maps owned files to upstream contracts; unit/native probe coverage exists for JSON boundaries, refresh policy, settings and account helpers.
entries.limitation: Quota/provider authentication is upstream/network dependent. Account-switch behavior and native module loading have separate acceptance; the open dense-account PR is not included.
entries.next_step: Preserve schema/settings and the complete taskbar layer on each upstream bump; check live snapshot and target account separately.
entries.delivery: Upstream CLI with custom native front end/helpers

entries.title: RepoBar dashboard and account-isolated caches
entries.provided: Independently implements a native GitHub dashboard, repository/CI/release/Pages links and per-account reads without switching the CLI’s global account.
entries.verification: The October 21 follow-up checks resolved-account pinning, per-account caches, stale-response rejection and private native error/account probes.
entries.limitation: Only one real signed-in account is recorded. Mocked second-account and private probes do not establish a live multi-account sign-in or newly loaded panel.
entries.next_step: Qualify a second owner-authorized account and confirm no old-account state appears across switch/error paths.
entries.delivery: Optional indicator/settings/helper

entries.title: Network throughput, usage views and Ethernet icon fixes
entries.provided: Combines pinned panel-network patches with selected UsageWidget/Wi-Fi changes and local usage logging. The canonical installer composes them explicitly.
entries.verification: Code inspection confirms selected-file patch application and idempotent UsageWidget wiring; historical records cover speed/saturation and Ethernet-icon fixes.
entries.limitation: The old netspeed README says the two patch sets cannot be combined, but the installer now composes selected parts. TCP polling does not fully attribute QUIC or short-lived connections.
entries.next_step: Keep the installer as the build entry point; reconcile the stale README and qualify real adapter replug/usage accuracy.
entries.delivery: Patched network indicator and optional logger

entries.title: Real iPhone SMS/iMessage through BlueFerry
entries.provided: Integrates BlueFerry’s Bluetooth MAP/MNS messaging and a version-matched scoped BlueZ 5.87 setup; native setup checks actual message access before declaring ready.
entries.verification: The October 20 sanitized qualification records authorized send/receive and incoming replies on J314S/iPhone. The upstream backend owns transport and encrypted history.
entries.limitation: This is nearby-phone messaging, not direct iCloud transport or a complete history import. ANCS, attachments and suspend/reboot recovery have separate limits.
entries.next_step: Qualify reconnect/resume without disturbing the working pairing; retain exact daemon/client identity.
entries.delivery: Experimental upstream backend plus local setup integration

entries.title: Native Messages UI with safe group confirmation
entries.provided: Provides conversation UI, drafts/retry, unread/name resolution, bounded HTTPS media-link previews and explicit roster-bound confirmation before group sends.
entries.verification: Source checks cover stale roster/address routing, duplicate sends, escaped rendering and preview limits; private GTK and real self-link evidence are documented.
entries.limitation: MAP attachment payloads remain unavailable. Inbox-list summaries can be truncated and are labeled. Real group-send and some input-method/live-preview acceptance remain open.
entries.next_step: Finish owner-confirmed group acceptance and live media/input checks without using fixture success as a sent-message result.
entries.delivery: Native GTK/Granite client of BlueFerry

entries.title: Import an ordered Apple Messages pin snapshot
entries.provided: Provides a read-only macOS export kit and native import/review matching. Local secret handling uses the system keyring rather than publishing contact identifiers.
entries.verification: Ordered/empty/missing/denied export and private write/readback tests are documented on macOS CI; import/matching/keyring tests exist.
entries.limitation: Actual owner export with SIP enabled is unverified. CI images have SIP disabled. Import is a snapshot, not continuous iPhone pin sync.
entries.next_step: Complete the small owner Mac export and reviewed import before planning a continuous synchronization adapter.
entries.delivery: Explicit export/import candidate

entries.title: Explicit verification-code suggestions and field fill
entries.provided: Adds a near-pointer code offer, explicit native accessible-field insertion and browser copy fallback; Messages stays the separate native client.
entries.verification: Private field/browser/shortcut fixtures cover stale offers, target checks and insertion boundaries.
entries.limitation: Live sign-in acceptance is not established by fixtures. The helper is not unrestricted browser autofill or a phone security-setting change.
entries.next_step: Qualify one owner-chosen sign-in surface and stale/focus refusal before expanding app coverage.
entries.delivery: Optional explicit suggestion helper

entries.title: Memory-only desktop notification popups
entries.provided: Implements freedesktop notification cards with supplied Open/Reply actions, replacement/expiry handling and existing DND integration.
entries.verification: October 20 records active installation, live synthetic geometry and private action/model tests. The implementation deliberately uses GTK3/XWayland positioning.
entries.limitation: No history, notification center, inline reply, image or sound is provided by this daemon. Per-app preferences, native Wayland placement and real phone click-to-focus remain open.
entries.next_step: Verify actual phone notification focus and next-login startup; assess history separately from the existing popup service.
entries.delivery: Installed popup service; history PR #350 excluded

entries.title: AirDrop controls and an unqualified Omdrop radio path
entries.provided: Vendors MIT Omdrop userspace and adds a native receive-control row. A separate explicit installer stages AWDL userspace helpers without replacing the kernel driver or activating the radio.
entries.verification: Private stub-backend controls and installer/preflight behavior are recorded; the vendor test scope has missing prerequisites and omitted core components.
entries.limitation: No real local send/receive acceptance is recorded. An upstream chip result is not this host’s result; installed controls do not mean AWDL is active.
entries.next_step: With the owner present, satisfy prerequisites and follow the staged radio/transfer plan with rollback.
entries.delivery: UI/userspace present; radio and real transfer unqualified

entries.title: Sound Output picker and AirPlay destination groups
entries.provided: Adds a native output list and optional PipeWire RAOP discovery/group controls. Audio transport remains PipeWire/RAOP.
entries.verification: Core/render tests and a silent group-stream exercise are documented.
entries.limitation: Audible playback, synchronization between receivers, actual Bluetooth/AirPlay switching and login startup are unverified. Dock HDMI audio has a separate experimental kernel/UCM gate.
entries.next_step: Qualify audible output switching and receiver sync; treat DCP dock audio as its own attended trial.
entries.delivery: Optional audio controls and RAOP integration

entries.title: Screen-share status and stale-heartbeat rejection
entries.provided: Adds native Share Eyes status/controls around the separate rupert-share backend. The freshness fix rejects future/invalid heartbeat times and clears stale credentials/URLs.
entries.verification: A regression against the original parser, native build and private light/dark future-state probes are retained.
entries.limitation: The fix report says no live panel/share installation. This is not full remote desktop or a new media pipeline; per-viewer browser encode cost remains unmeasured.
entries.next_step: Stage through canonical Quick Settings preparation, verify actual freshness and collect matched sharing-cost baselines before media changes.
entries.delivery: Backend integration with source-only freshness follow-up

entries.title: Native Calendar Events, Tasks and GitHub agenda
entries.provided: Extends the datetime panel with upcoming/month/week/day events, EDS tasks, explicit completion/addition, GitHub tracking and optional daily/study content.
entries.verification: Private EDS agenda/native checks and installed panel records exist, including recurrence, rollback/error and Today-navigation fixes.
entries.limitation: Real Google OAuth/remote round trip, full physical interaction and all recurrence providers are not implied by isolated local EDS tests.
entries.next_step: Complete owner account sign-in and a known remote event/task round trip, preserving source selection.
entries.delivery: Patched elementary datetime indicator

entries.title: Homeboard task bridge and launcher
entries.provided: Installs a pinned bridge between Homeboard and elementary Tasks/EDS, with restart/backoff/keyring handling and calendar Sign In entry points.
entries.verification: The roadmap records the bridge installed/running but signed out; local agenda source tests do not authenticate a remote account.
entries.limitation: No successful owner Google/Homeboard round trip is established by service presence.
entries.next_step: Complete explicit Sign In and verify completion/readback in both Homeboard and the EDS task view.
entries.delivery: Optional external bridge; owner sign-in pending

entries.title: Local MLX assistants with memory and cooling guards
entries.provided: Configures pinned private Linux MLX/model profiles, Newelle chat/summary memory and guarded coding workflows while retaining desktop memory/cooling reserves.
entries.verification: Retained app/tool fixtures and measured model comparisons support specific 4B defaults; model-worker admission and interruption behavior is implemented.
entries.limitation: Model quality is task-specific. Larger profiles can exceed reserve; a fan guard is not a noise measurement. Earlier Ornith/Hermes and speech descriptions are historical.
entries.next_step: Reuse the qualification queue and evaluate only materially changed model/app cases with exact identities.
entries.delivery: Optional supervised upstream model/app stack

entries.title: Sixteen scoped local MCP tools
entries.provided: Provides bounded workspace reads/create-only notes, dedicated Assistant Tasks/Calendar writes, managed-browser reads and unsent local mail drafts; no generic shell tool.
entries.verification: Adapter, retry/conflict and independent EDS/RFC822 outcomes are retained. The integration report distinguishes controller/API discovery from actual Newelle GUI dispatch.
entries.limitation: Not general app control: no normal-profile browsing, arbitrary task edits, inbox access, mail sending or unrestricted files. The sixteen-schema Newelle GUI workflow gate is still pending in its report.
entries.next_step: Finish the queued actual-controller positive/hostile-page cases without duplicating completed inference trials.
entries.delivery: Scoped stdio adapter, not universal desktop automation

entries.title: English F5 streaming dictation with stable-only field output
entries.provided: Integrates Nemotron CPU with optional native engines and a guarded IBus field lease. Stable words stream; unsafe speculative app composition is suppressed; grammar stays separate.
entries.verification: The qualification ledger retains public-file ASR/toolkit/real-app successes and failures. The later physical ChatGPT F5 attempt failed before capture; a launcher fix is staged.
entries.limitation: Earlier file-audio successes do not erase the current app-specific physical failure. v0.0.1 is an unpublished desktop-update candidate, not an accepted stable speech release.
entries.next_step: After the owner’s full ChatGPT relaunch, perform the pending human microphone-to-field acceptance for that exact candidate.
entries.delivery: Installed/staged candidate; specific human F5 gate unresolved

entries.title: Voice reply and alternate speech-engine experiments
entries.provided: Retains optional native engine controllers and synthetic English WAV/voice completion work, separate from the English STT candidate.
entries.verification: The qualification ledger separates real ASR, replayed ASR events, LLM/WAV completion and preserved harness failures.
entries.limitation: A generated WAV or replay is not live conversational microphone/playback acceptance. These experiments are not the delivered STT-only v0.0.1 scope.
entries.next_step: Resume only the explicitly selected incomplete stage after checking the ledger/owned queue; do not repeat completed trials.
entries.delivery: Retained optional experiments

entries.title: Bounded fault collection and optional local diagnosis
entries.provided: Collects/deduplicates bounded current/previous-boot failure signatures and offers a native troubleshooting view. Optional model diagnosis never executes suggested repairs.
entries.verification: The watcher is recorded active; source tests and retained model-quality failures distinguish deterministic collection from analysis quality.
entries.limitation: The 4B repair-advice route failed qualification. Optional 9B analysis has separate memory/admission limits and remains unqualified for the retained app mix.
entries.next_step: Validate deterministic evidence completeness first; keep automatic diagnosis off until the selected model/workload is qualified.
entries.delivery: Deterministic watcher plus optional unqualified model diagnosis

entries.title: Optional read-only Apple Passwords integration
entries.provided: Provides unofficial client installation, a native setup/vault UI, local helper and Brave extension integration, with keyring-backed storage and explicit recovery handling.
entries.verification: Source checks cover setup/auth/network/GUI boundaries. The installer is disabled by default and does not request credentials itself.
entries.limitation: Owner authentication and account trust are separate. No writes of new passwords to iCloud, passkeys, native-app autofill or Advanced Data Protection qualification is claimed.
entries.next_step: Qualify an explicitly selected owner login/recovery/autofill path without logging or publishing real vault data.
entries.delivery: Off-by-default unofficial account integration

entries.title: Teams and Outlook web launchers with official icons
entries.provided: Adds desktop/app-window launchers, pinned official icon fetching, profile selection and ordered dock-pin preservation; Outlook leaves the mailto handler unchanged.
entries.verification: Offline launcher/icon tests and owner Teams Brave sign-in are recorded. Launcher dispatch does not inspect or copy browser authentication databases.
entries.limitation: These are Microsoft web clients, not native GTK clients. Meetings/media/sharing and Outlook mailbox operations remain unverified; browser support differs by mode.
entries.next_step: Qualify the actual tenant’s messaging, camera/mic and sharing in the selected browser mode.
entries.delivery: Optional web-client integration

entries.title: Native Orchard manager for Incus
entries.provided: Provides native Incus instance/resource management, conflict-aware edits, snapshots/backups, logs, panel controls and optional model endpoint/sandbox UI.
entries.verification: The upstream-parity report classifies 131 capability rows with explicit adaptations/incompatibilities; native/private runtime and soak evidence is retained.
entries.limitation: This is not identical upstream Orchard or a container engine. Incus 6.0.5 lacks later OCI features; sandbox configuration is not a security guarantee.
entries.next_step: Complete remaining real Wayland/manual operations and keep version-specific parity gaps explicit.
entries.delivery: Optional native client for an existing Incus daemon

entries.title: Machine Lab and ARM64 guest tooling
entries.provided: Adds a QEMU/KVM manager, VM inventory/lifecycle, QMP pause/resume and display, image/snapshot support, optional Windows driver media and Incus views.
entries.verification: The README records headless-QEMU pause/resume and GTK Broadway display/input checks. Separate VM tools retain elementary/Omarchy boot observations.
entries.limitation: A complete automatic new guest install, native Wayland keyboard path and unattended Windows setup are not all qualified. Experimental macOS collection is not a supported Linux macOS guest.
entries.next_step: Complete one fresh guest install end to end and qualify native display/input and shutdown recovery.
entries.delivery: Optional native manager and VM CLI

entries.title: 4 KiB microVM route for x86 emulation
entries.provided: Builds pinned muvm/libkrun/libkrunfw and uses FEX inside a 4 KiB guest to address the host’s 16 KiB-page incompatibility. Source caches now require immutable identity and cleanliness.
entries.verification: The retained command returned x86_64 and 4096; the October 21 provenance fix has offline regression coverage.
entries.limitation: A command-level microVM pass is not broad x86 app, GPU, sound or package compatibility. No rebuild/deployment occurred during the provenance fix.
entries.next_step: Qualify one selected app and a future rebuild against the pinned source identities and rollback path.
entries.delivery: Optional upstream emulation stack and downstream installer

entries.title: Private native Torrential packaging recipe
entries.provided: Provides a downstream recipe for an optional upstream Rust/GTK Torrential fork using system Transmission, with local policy and backend integration.
entries.verification: The port record retains an installed ARM64 app and a successful Ubuntu torrent transfer; later review found no newer upstream source to import.
entries.limitation: The audited upstream snapshot lacks a license grant. The recipe is not permission to redistribute the app or ship it in the public factory image; native fork CI also needs work.
entries.next_step: Resolve source licensing and native branch validation before any public package/image inclusion.
entries.delivery: Optional private build recipe; public redistribution blocked

entries.title: Experimental ARM64 image factory
entries.provided: Extends elementary’s mkosi/live-ISO wiring with the Apple layer, reproducible build records, checksum/payload checks and artifact-only CI.
entries.verification: A corrected ARM64 ISO reached the graphical installer in QEMU. Desktop transformations and VM boot are separate from an Apple hardware image boot.
entries.limitation: No stable ISO release or physical Apple factory boot is qualified. Kernel, firmware and audio/fresh-install parity remain gates; old Actions installers may expire.
entries.next_step: Close exact image payload gaps and complete attended Apple installer/post-boot acceptance before publishing a stable image.
entries.delivery: Experimental build artifacts; no qualified stable ISO

entries.title: Additive omarchy-to-elementary transform scaffolding
entries.provided: Supplies a dry-run/review-oriented transform path designed to add an elementary environment/boot entry beside an existing omarchy-mac install.
entries.verification: The design and shell entry point exist; source/config checks are distinct from a successful full transform.
entries.limitation: The mseries README still labels the transform untested. Cloning this repository does not perform or qualify installation.
entries.next_step: Review dry-run output and recovery prerequisites on the exact target before any attended apply.
entries.delivery: Untested transform source; no unattended install claim

entries.title: Installer timing, opt-in scheduling and immutable sources
entries.provided: Adds stage timing, a default-serial/opt-in parallel module graph with apt/panel locks, optional ccache and pinned-source verification for selected builds.
entries.verification: Hermetic fake-module/install/compiler tests are retained. The 2.49× example uses synthetic sleep-only modules.
entries.limitation: The documented 2.49× synthetic timing is not a real Mac install speedup. Parallel build/resource interactions need measured first-boot acceptance.
entries.next_step: Measure serial versus parallel real installs under matched conditions before changing defaults or quoting gains.
entries.delivery: Opt-in source/build improvements; defaults remain serial

scope: Source, installation wiring, check definitions and retained public evidence at the pinned revision. No new host deployment, live hardware experiment, account action or model benchmark was performed by this audit.

exclusions.title: Notification history and a dock notification center
exclusions.reason: Open PR #350 is outside the audited dev tree; existing popups retain no history.

exclusions.title: Full remote desktop host and phone control
exclusions.reason: Open PR #390 is separate from the provided Share Eyes/screen-share integration.

exclusions.title: Dense CodexBar account legend
exclusions.reason: Open PR #373 is not part of the audited source baseline.

exclusions.title: Stable factory ISO, Touch ID passkeys and continuous iPhone pin sync
exclusions.reason: These outcomes remain unqualified; source, UI controls or snapshots are not acceptance of them.

exclusions.title: General Adobe/Office replacement suite
exclusions.reason: The historical ArtCraft opportunity is not an implemented, licensed and qualified suite supplied by this project.

findings.title: A missing mapper was presented as a port gap
findings.detail: Pantheon accepts a mono source; the Quickshell-specific stereo mapper is deliberately omitted. Keep real recording acceptance separate.

findings.title: “Installed” blurred compositor and session boundaries
findings.detail: Gala drawers/corners, staged Rust updates and currently loaded code need separate labels. Package installation does not activate every behavior.

findings.title: Broad speech success hid a later app-specific failure
findings.detail: Public-file/toolkit successes remain valid, while physical F5 in ChatGPT failed before capture and needs post-relaunch human acceptance.

findings.title: Native controls were easy to mistake for working transport
findings.detail: AirDrop radio/transfer, audible AirPlay and real second-account RepoBar acceptance remain narrower than their UI/build tests.

findings.title: The network README lagged behind the installer
findings.detail: The current installer composes selected patch files and wires UsageWidget. The old instruction to choose either entire patch set is historical.

findings.title: An experimental package had advanced beyond the old summary
findings.detail: Wip3 now has a merged unarmed-staging receipt, while its candidate source remains separate and hardware boot is still unqualified.

findings.title: Public packaging requires more than a successful local app
findings.detail: Torrential’s absent audited license grant blocks public redistribution despite a retained local transfer result.

findings.title: Synthetic and unmatched numbers cannot establish gains
findings.detail: Installer fake-module timing and unmatched compositor/power samples must retain their workload and measurement limits.
